about.label: self-application demonstration
about.inv_s4: Written by a context that is not the distiller (INV-S4, design §7.1 line 259): Claude Opus 5.5 in the S3 part C context, 2026-09-30. This context has not distilled and will not distil the Skill. It will not draw the second subject's seed, and it will not compute or see that subject's reference. It fixes the form of the conditions (which comparison, how many runs) before any distillation, and it decides no pass or fail.
about.same_operator: Every context here is directed by the same operator. Separating contexts is not independence of persons (cf. design §6.3 line 230); the whole remains a self-application demonstration.
about.notice_basis: INV-S3 (design §4.1 line 84) exempts only records whose form a tool or schema fixes, because those cannot carry a notice at their head. This file's form is authored here, it describes the fictional subject, and it belongs to the fixed set (design §5 line 146), so its first key carries the notice.
about.state: Part of the fixed set: hash-fixed and timestamped before the first checker launch and before any distillation (INV-S2, INV-S4). After fixing, any change is a new version kept beside this one and marked post hoc.

roles.distiller: The context that distils a Skill (S7 for stage 0, S8 for stage 1). It writes no condition in this file and changes none. It does not write the Tier-3 JobSpec, the reference or the run count used to judge its Skill, and it issues no pass or fail for its Skill (INV-S4). It never sees the second subject, the second seed, or the reference.
roles.reference_context: A context other than the distiller. It draws the second seed, generates the second subject, and computes and fixes the reference.
roles.judge: Tier 3, the checker, launched by a context other than the distiller, on a JobSpec that context wrote.

stage_0.what: The object-level stage: an RNA-seq differential-expression Skill distilled from V0's pipeline (design §7.2 line 266; O-1, operator decision 2026-09-29).
stage_0.precondition: V0's pipeline has passed Tier 3: its S4c Tier-3 cell met selfapp/expected_v1.json cells.V0.T3 (comparison_verdict match_exact, self_consistency.all_identical true). Tier 4 claims nothing before that (design §0 line 23).
stage_0.skill_parameters_note: The first four are design §7.2 line 266. permutation_seed and permutation_draws are added because the permutation p-values enter Supplementary Table S1, and both values come from the subject's config/config.yaml (generator/templates/config.yaml.erb:9-10).
order: 2. The Skill's package digest is recorded, with the time of recording. The digest uses the S-1 tree rule: sha256 over the lines "<sha256>  <relative path>\n" of every regular file in the package, dot files included, symlinks not followed, sorted bytewise by path (scripts/selfapp/ddc_common.rb:12-24).
3. The reference context draws the second seed (other_data_check.seed_rule).
4. The reference context generates the second subject, then computes and fixes its reference (other_data_check.reference).
5. The Skill is applied to V0's data and to the second subject.
stage_0.package_condition: No file in the recorded package has sha256 22fe3ff699a91e4ded9a3f58fc0996b95c9bff817c294e0421f2fda68e02508a (V0's declared S1). This is checked on the recorded package before step 5; if it fails, the reversion check is reported as failed without being run.

reversion_check.apply_to: V0's data: the frozen V0 subject's reads, its SynthRef release 3 reference files and its sample table. The Skill's parameters are set to V0's values: the sample table config/samples.tsv, the reference files under data/synthetic_reference/, V0's comparison, the threshold padj < 0.05, and permutation_seed and permutation_draws as in V0's config/config.yaml.
reversion_check.starting_directory: A fresh directory holding only the Skill package and V0's input data. It has no results/, no manuscript, and no file with sha256 22fe3ff6... (the same rule as expected_v1.json rules.tier3.working_directory).
reversion_check.runs_basis: The criterion is one sha256 equality (design §7.2 line 266). exact_sha256 with a file: target compares the first run's file only (tier3_executor.rb:150-158), and the tool emits only the first run's output_files (gc_tier3_execute.rb:257-281), so more runs add nothing to the criterion. Run-to-run agreement of the source computation is already covered by V0's control.
reversion_check.fail: Any other outcome, including a run that does not complete, or a table written anywhere other than results/synthetic_supplementary_table_S1.tsv in the working directory: no file is found there, so the result is mismatch (comparator.rb:67-80).

other_data_check.second_subject: Generated by the same generator as V0 (selfapp/generator; tree sha256 as recorded in selfapp/synthetic_rnaseq_v1/generator_manifest.json), with the same Ruby version and only the seed changed.
other_data_check.seed_rule: The seed is drawn only after step 2's package digest is recorded. The reference context draws it with Ruby's SecureRandom. Every draw is recorded with its time before it is used, and the first draw is taken (design §5 line 146; §7.1 line 259).
other_data_check.permutation_settings: Both the reference run and the Skill use permutation_seed and permutation_draws from the second subject's config/config.yaml as generated. There permutation_seed equals the second subject's generator seed (generator/templates/config.yaml.erb:10), and permutation_draws is the generator's setting (config.yaml.erb:9). Neither run may override them.
other_data_check.reference: The original V0 pipeline (V0's Snakefile and scripts, run in container image sha256:004c13e8611f445b5be24dcac9749edd0a38a0aa136a0642a88c9ee7ee236504, tag synthetic-rnaseq:1.0 as an alias only), applied by the reference context to the second subject after the seed is drawn and before the Skill is applied. The reference is that run's results/synthetic_supplementary_table_S1.tsv; its sha256 is recorded, with the time, before step 5.
other_data_check.reference_rule: The reference is fixed only if both runs of the original pipeline produce byte-identical tables, compared with sha256sum. The checker is not used here, as in the V0 calibration. If the tables differ, no reference is fixed, and the other-data check is reported as not performed.

expected_output.sha256: the reference sha256 recorded before step 5
expected_output.source_citation: the reference record: original V0 pipeline applied to the second subject

comparison.source_basis: The reference is not declared by a paper, so the source is operator_supplied (tier3_verdict.schema.json:144).
comparison.validated_by_note: null: the schema means an independent validator (tier3_verdict.schema.json:152-154), and the field is signed (verdict_spec/tier3.rb:22). The reference context is directed by the same operator (about.same_operator), so it is not independent. The note sits outside expected_output, because the schema closes that object (additionalProperties false, tier3_verdict.schema.json:157) and gc_tier3_execute passes it verbatim (gc_tier3_execute.rb:304).

other_data_check.blinding: The distilling context never sees the second subject, its seed or its reference, before or after step 5 (INV-S4).
other_data_check.status_of_result: Recorded as an observation. It does not assert correctness (warranty-scope; design §7.1 line 260).

stage_0.shows: That parameterisation did not change the original computation: applied to V0's data, the Skill gives V0's declared table byte for byte. And on one second subject drawn after the Skill was fixed, the Skill gives the same table as the original pipeline on the same data (design §7.2 lines 266, 269).
does_not_show: That the generalisation is correct (design §7.2 line 269). One second subject is one observation.
Behaviour on data other than V0 and the one second subject, including any real data.
Scientific validity of the analysis or its interpretation. Interpretation text in the Skill is not judged (design §7.1 lines 258, 260; warranty-scope).
That the Skill carries none of V0's answer inside its code. The package condition catches only a verbatim copy of the declared table; the other-data check is what speaks to this.
Independence: this is a self-application demonstration, not an independent verdict (design §2 line 43).

stage_1.what: The meta stage: a Skill distilled from the computation the draft declares, "the deterministic Tiers applied to V0-V8 give this verdict table" (design §7.2 line 267).
stage_1.precondition: S8 has first obtained a Tier-3 pass for the draft's computation. That run is the source of the jobspec_digest and result_hash cited in the Skill's provenance (design §7.3 line 274; §10 S8 line 315).
deterministic_tiers_only: T1 replay on V0 and V1
stage_1.excluded: LLM scoring, meaning live Tier-1 runs. It varies between re-runs, so it cannot enter a computation compared by exact match (design §7.2 line 270).
skill_parameters: the subject generator and the variant spec

reversion_check.apply_to: The same variants V0-V8 and the same inputs_manifest.json.

expected_output.target: file:<the path at which the draft declares the verdict table>
expected_output.sha256: the sha256 the draft declares for that table
expected_output.source_citation: the draft section that declares the table

reversion_check.not_yet_fixed: The table's path and the draft's citation are fixed when the draft declares them in S8, before the stage-1 distillation, by a context that is not the stage-1 distiller.

stage_1.other_data_check: Not performed in v0.1 (D11; O-11; design §7.2 line 267, §11 line 336).
stage_1.shows: That the draft's computation, re-expressed as a Skill, reproduces the verdict table the draft declares.
does_not_show: Behaviour on other subjects or other variants (O-11 is deferred to v0.2).
Anything about LLM scoring, which is excluded.
